blurb: Guests can rent sit-on-top Ocean Kayaks, standup paddle boards, various bicycles including cruisers and tandems, surrey bikes, and electric golf carts. Kayak eco-tours explore local wildlife and habitats including dolphins, manatees, and bird rookeries. Free delivery and pick up to vacation rentals on Anna Maria Island is available for equipment small enough to fit in their truck.
